info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Methods-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Methods API enables businesses to list available payment methods for processing transactions. This endpoint is essential for developers looking to integrate payment solutions into their platforms, allowing them to present users with various payment options. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial applications that require flexible payment configurations. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance user experience by offering suitable payment alternatives tailored to different market segments.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch a list of all available payment methods that can be used for processing transactions. It includes details such as method type, identification, and any applicable transaction limits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for retrieving the available payment methods. It should contain criteria that the client wishes to apply in order to filter the payment methods returned by the API.
